title: ZED Agent Release State
description: Schema for release.json — per-release runtime artifact tracking release owner, branch names, dates, build/SafeFly/EV2 identifiers, and the commit Excel URL.

alias.description: Release owner MS alias (the part before @microsoft.com).

currentBranch.description: Name of the release branch being deployed (e.g., 'Release-2604').

previousBranch.description: Name of the previous release branch (used for rollback in Step 7).

triggeredPipelines.description: Map of step number → array of pipeline run IDs triggered by that step. Written at trigger time for rollback/recovery (e.g., Step 7 reads Step 5's triggered set). Keys are string step numbers.

pipelineTriggerTimestamps.description: Map of step number → ISO-8601 timestamp recorded BEFORE the pipeline is triggered. BVT query windows (Steps 6, 8, 11) use these as their start bound. Must be written atomically before trigger.

step4InlineCompleted.description: True after Step 4 Phase A (inline) work is done.

step4ExcelUrl.description: OneDrive/SharePoint URL of the commit Excel file.

step4ExcelImpactPct.description: Percentage of Excel rows with Impact column filled.

step4NudgeSentAt.description: Timestamp of the 24h nudge message, used for dedup.
